_comment: Expected on-disk size (MB, after the layers are unpacked) of each image a scan can download, keyed by image name without registry, path or tag. image_size_mb and image_size_note in source-detect.sh read it, and so do the disk checks in scan-sbom.sh, entrypoint.sh and check-setup. Measured with the cdxgen tag in docker/lib/cdxgen-images.json (for 13.8.0, the 13.5.0 measurement scaled by the growth of the compressed layers); measure again when that tag changes (scripts/update-cdxgen-digests.sh reminds you). An image not listed here has no size note and no disk check.
